author: hatakeyamak
body:
#### PR description:

This PR will allow running MLPF for the barrel and HF regions. For now, we are using the same training from Run 3.
We also defined matrix test workflow for MLPF for Phase 2. The particle flow validation is also updated so that we can run and test MLPF using crab or CERN condor.

#### PR validation:

Particle flow validation plots:
https://hep.baylor.edu/hatake/PFval2/CMSSW_20_0_0/plots_mlpf_v3/
At low-middle jet pt range, MLPF is comparable to (or better than) traditional PF.

https://indico.cern.ch/event/1729145/#16-mlpf-in-barrel-phase2-enabl
has more information.

This PR is tested with `workflow_opts = -w upgrade` and:
```
16834.13_TTbar_14TeV+2025_mlpf
16843.13_QCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14+2025_mlpf

18434.13_TTbar_14TeV+2026_mlpf
18443.13_QCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14+2026_mlpf

34434.13_TTbar_14TeV+Run4D121_mlpf
34443.13_QCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14+Run4D121_mlpf
34634.13_TTbar_14TeV+Run4D121PU_mlpf
34643.13_QCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14+Run4D121PU_mlpf
```
